name: Grizzled Den
summary: Wendigo packs make their lair in Grizzled Den, southwest of Kharanos in Dun Morogh.

sections.title: A Frost-Chilled Lair
sections.body: Grizzled Den cuts into the crags southwest of Kharanos, where Dun Morogh’s wendigo packs make their home. These aggressive, ape-like beasts breathe frost at intruders and band together to defend their hollows. Hunters brave the cavern for the thick wendigo manes, which craftsmen use to line cold chairs and carriage seats with insulated fur.

sections.title: Hidden Treasures
sections.body: Prospectors enter Grizzled Den to work copper veins in its frozen stone walls, and scouts search its darker corners for discarded footlockers. The deeper tunnels hold the den’s largest and most vicious predators, waiting in the shadows.

faq.q: Where is the Grizzled Den located?
aliases: how to get to grizzled den
faq.answer: Grizzled Den lies in Dun Morogh, southwest of Kharanos, among the snow-covered mountain ridges.

faq.q: What creatures live in the Grizzled Den?
faq.answer: Packs of ferocious wendigos live in Grizzled Den. The white-furred beasts breathe freezing frost and swarm intruders.

faq.q: Why do people venture into the Grizzled Den?
faq.answer: Hunters seek wendigo manes for warm seat covers, while others venture into the tunnels to mine copper from the walls.

angles.text: Copper deposits run through Grizzled Den’s outer and inner tunnels, though wendigos make mining there dangerous.
For young dwarven mountaineers training around Kharanos, clearing Grizzled Den is a rite of passage.
